nodes.text:
Season:2019 (2019): The Formula One season during which Charles Leclerc signed for Ferrari.
The Formula One championship season.
The Formula One season in which Charles Leclerc achieved multiple victories.
Leclerc became the youngest recipient of the FIA Pole Trophy in 2019 for achieving the most pole positions.

GrandPrix:canadian grand prix (Canadian Grand Prix): The race where Charles Leclerc qualified and finished third.
A Formula One race held in Canada.
A Formula One race where Charles Leclerc started nineteenth and finished fifth.
A race in the 2023 Formula One season.
Car:cadillac dpi-v.r (Cadillac DPi-V.R): A chassis model shared by Alonso.
Car:dallara ir18-chevrolet (Dallara IR18-Chevrolet): The car model Alonso was set to race.

Circuit:circuit gilles villeneuve (Circuit Gilles Villeneuve): The circuit where the Canadian Grand Prix took place.
The circuit where the race was held.

Driver:thierry boutsen (Thierry Boutsen): The driver who won the Canadian and Australian Grands Prix for Williams-Renault.
A notable driver for Williams.
A driver who raced for Williams Racing in the 1989 season.
GrandPrix:grand prix of canada (Grand Prix of Canada): The race that took place at Circuit Gilles Villeneuve.

Car:r.s.19 (R.S.19): The car model used by Renault during the 2019 season.

Car:ts050 hybrid (TS050 Hybrid): The car model used by Toyota in the championship.
The car driven by Alonso in the FIA World Endurance Championship.
Driver:david tonizza (David Tonizza): A driver who won the Formula One Esports Drivers' Championship for Scuderia Ferrari Esports Team in 2019.
GrandPrix:2019 japanese grand prix (2019 Japanese Grand Prix): A race from which Renault was disqualified.

GrandPrix:azerbaijan (Azerbaijan): A Formula One race held in Azerbaijan.
The fourth race of the 2019 season where Verstappen finished fourth.
